scope: Small source-respectful public research pass, not catalog ingestion or comprehensive survey. Facts paraphrased; no copied photos or descriptions.
identity_rules: Store source label, seller, breeder, accession and generation separately. Trade shorthand is not a taxonomic synonym.
FSRL and RLFS are distinct ordered labels, not interchangeable aliases. Label order alone is not independently verified maternal/paternal direction.
A named cross describes potentially many genetically different seedlings, not one clone. A selfed offspring is not its parent's clone.
RC is ambiguous without provenance. Do not merge all Red Crystallinum stock with NSE, Tezula or DocBlock lines, or identify it automatically as pure crystallinum.
Retail pedigree statements are reports, not genetic verification. Do not infer fertility, success rates or compatibility probabilities.

remaining_gaps: Obtain primary experimental Sheffer/Kamemoto 1976 and 1978 full texts before extracting successful/failed pair matrices.
